utterances.text: Morning Sam, thanks for joining. Let's start the weekly check-in with a quick recap.
Sure. The designs are finished, and testing wrapped up on Tuesday. The only open point is the launch video.
Right. Tell me about the agency quote.
Yes, this morning. The team has looked at it, and nobody had any concerns.
Good. We agreed to go with the agency quote of $4,500 for the launch video.
Great. The agency needs a week to edit, so the video will land close to the launch. Do we need captions on it?
Not sure yet. I will send the signed quote to the agency by Wednesday.
I'll update the help articles by Friday. I will also share the launch checklist today.
Thanks. The review with the support team still needs to be booked before next Monday.
Understood. The store screenshots are finished, so that part is done.
Perfect. That is everything for this week. Thanks Sam.
